description: This file provides utility functions for reading file contents if they exist and collecting plugin source information from a specific directory within a repository. It scans through 'extensions' directories, reads plugin manifests and optionally package.json files, and returns structured data about the plugins found.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads the content of the specified file synchronously if it exists; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Collects and returns information about plugins bundled in the 'extensions' directory of the repository, optionally requiring their package.json files.
